observations.note: For later-feature backward deduction, no gain supports a positive inference and no loss a negative one. The paper distinguishes these entailment conditions from probabilistic evidence, record-based routes and awareness already covering the earlier interval. Its coached-vision analysis and negative inventory countermodel separate local accuracy, common historical target and domain completeness. It acknowledges direct precedents and establishes no actual human transition model; significance depends on the value of the diagnostic reconstruction.

The relevant lost activity is revising one's actually favored but false interpretation through the work's expressive form. An invented film and Emma develop a positive aesthetic premise; the text grants that an informed viewer can feel menace, imagine correction, appreciate the construction and enjoy it more. Reasonable 0.6 confidence need not have been irrational. The conditional sequencing recommendation avoids claiming total value dominance or condemning voluntary help.

The model distinguishes complete exclusion by about29.7% from positive residual weighting by all, with the same exact conviction rates. It explicitly concedes that12.3% in the latter model change action due to the rule, so it does not refute a broader action-based account of exclusion or Sekine's broader defence. Small stimulus-weight variations still tie; d=0.6 separates the fixed extensions under extra assumptions. Source qualification and self-selected subgroups are acknowledged; the actual philosophical target must remain the narrow stronger reading.
